title: Mixing: Seaside Woman by Suzy And The Red Stripes | 1977
content:
Studio B, CBS Studio Building, New York City

A mixing session Linda McCartney’s song ‘Seaside Woman’ took place on 5 January 1977.

The song had been recorded by Wings on 20 and 21 March 1972, but had remained in the vault for five years. With Paul McCartney out of contract with EMI/Capitol, discussions on a new record deal were underway with a number of labels.

Linda’s single became a potential sweetener, with Columbia agreeing to release it on its Epic label. MPL shipped the multitrack tapes to New York for this mixing session, which the members of Wings did not attend. The new mix was named the ‘Eastman Special Mix’.

The single was released in the US by Epic in May 1977, and August 1979 by A&M in the UK.
